name: Night Fury
description: A sleek black dragon so fast and so rarely seen that Vikings had no record of what it looked like. It fires concentrated blasts and disappears against the night sky.

name: Light Fury
description: A pale relative of the Night Fury that can almost vanish from sight by flying through its own fire. Wild and very wary of people.

name: Night Light
description: The hatchlings of a Night Fury and a Light Fury, seen at the very end of the third film.

name: Deadly Nadder
description: A colourful, bird-like dragon with a crown of horns and a tail that fires spines. Quick on its feet and proud of its looks.

name: Gronckle
description: A round, heavy dragon whose small wings beat fast like a bumblebee's. Slow to anger and much tougher than it looks.

name: Hideous Zippleback
description: A two-headed dragon: one head breathes out gas and the other lights it, so both heads have to cooperate.

name: Monstrous Nightmare
description: A big, hot-tempered dragon that can set its own body on fire. Fierce, loud and hard to handle.

name: Terrible Terror
description: A cat-sized dragon that turns up in groups and squabbles over food.

name: Red Death
description: A gigantic dragon that ruled the dragons' nest and forced smaller dragons to bring it food.

name: Boneknapper
description: A dragon that wears the bones of others as armour. One of the entries in Berk's Book of Dragons.

name: Changewing
description: A dragon that changes colour to blend into its surroundings. One of the entries in Berk's Book of Dragons.

name: Scauldron
description: A sea dragon that sprays scalding water instead of fire. One of the entries in Berk's Book of Dragons.

name: Skrill
description: A dragon associated with lightning. One of the entries in Berk's Book of Dragons.

name: Thunderdrum
description: A sea dragon whose roar is loud enough to stun. One of the entries in Berk's Book of Dragons.

name: Timberjack
description: A dragon with huge, blade-like wings that can slice through trees. One of the entries in Berk's Book of Dragons.

name: Whispering Death
description: A burrowing dragon with rings of teeth that tunnels through rock. One of the entries in Berk's Book of Dragons.

name: Smothering Smokebreath
description: A small dragon that hides inside clouds of smoke it makes itself.

name: Snaptrapper
description: A many-headed dragon whose jaws open like petals to lure prey in.

name: Speed Stinger
description: A small, flightless dragon that runs very fast and can paralyse with its sting.

name: Stormcutter
description: A large dragon with four wings that can spread into an X, and an owl-like face.

name: Rumblehorn
description: A heavy dragon with a hammer-shaped snout and a strong sense of smell, good at tracking.

name: Hotburple
description: A heavy, sleepy cousin of the Gronckle that swallows rocks and spits out lava.

name: Bewilderbeast
description: A colossal, tusked alpha dragon that breathes ice and can command other dragons.

name: Scuttleclaw
description: A small, lively dragon; young ones appear in the second and third films.

name: Seashocker
description: A sea dragon that can give off electric shocks.

name: Hobblegrunt
description: A dragon whose colours change with its mood.

name: Raincutter
description: A spiky-framed dragon that prefers rain and grey skies.

name: Shovelhelm
description: A dragon with a broad, shovel-shaped head.

name: Snafflefang
description: A sharp-toothed dragon that likes to gnaw on rocks.

name: Snifflehunch
description: A curious dragon with a keen nose that sniffs out friend or foe.

name: Threadtail
description: A long, slender dragon with a thin, whip-like tail.

name: Windgnasher
description: A hump-backed dragon that can catch a scent carried on the wind.

name: Windstriker
description: A dragon that blasts super-heated air instead of flame.

name: Songwing
description: A dragon with a small body and very large wings.

name: Submaripper
description: A huge sea dragon said to drag ships under with whirlpools.

name: Typhoomerang
description: A dragon that spins as it flies, leaving a spiral of fire behind it.

name: Deathgripper
description: A spiky, aggressive dragon with a venomous, pincer-like tail. The dragon hunter Grimmel uses them as his attack pack.

name: Crimson Goregutter
description: A large, antlered dragon that looks fierce but mostly wants to be left alone.

name: Hobgobbler
description: A small, round dragon that many Vikings believe brings bad luck.

name: Fireworm
description: A tiny dragon whose body burns so hot that it glows.

name: Buffalord
description: A huge, bison-like dragon.

name: Dramillion
description: A dragon that imitates the fire of other dragons.

name: Singetail
description: A territorial dragon that can shoot fire from its mouth, gills and tail.

name: Toothless
description: Hiccup's Night Fury. Loses half of his tail fin, can only fly with Hiccup's help, becomes his closest friend and later the alpha of all dragons.

name: Stormfly
description: Astrid's Deadly Nadder. Quick, loyal and competitive.

name: Meatlug
description: Fishlegs's Gronckle. Gentle and affectionate.

name: Hookfang
description: Snotlout's Monstrous Nightmare. Stubborn, and often ignores his rider.

name: Barf & Belch
description: The Zippleback ridden by the twins Ruffnut and Tuffnut, one twin per head.

name: The Red Death
description: The giant queen of the dragons' nest, defeated by Hiccup and Toothless at the end of the first film.

name: Cloudjumper
description: Valka's Stormcutter, who carried her away from Berk years before the second film.

name: Skullcrusher
description: A Rumblehorn ridden by Stoick in the second film and by Eret in the third.

name: Grump
description: Gobber's sleepy Hotburple.

name: Valka's Bewilderbeast
description: The alpha that sheltered the dragons of Valka's ice sanctuary.

name: Drago's Bewilderbeast
description: The alpha controlled by Drago Bludvist, used to take command of other dragons.

name: The Light Fury
description: A wild Light Fury who becomes Toothless's mate.

name: The Night Lights
description: Toothless and the Light Fury's three hatchlings, seen at the end of the third film.

name: Gothi's Pet
description: Gothi's Terrible Terror.

name: Gruff
description: A blind Hobblegrunt rescued by Valka.

name: Thump
description: One of the dragons living in Valka's sanctuary.

name: Lump
description: One of the dragons living in Valka's sanctuary.

name: Rumpus
description: One of the dragons living in Valka's sanctuary.

name: Sailback
description: One of the dragons living in Valka's sanctuary.

name: Winged Warden
description: One of the dragons living in Valka's sanctuary.

name: Pestbud
description: One of the dragons living in Valka's sanctuary.

name: Clawlifter
description: One of the dragons living in Valka's sanctuary.

name: Gustnudger
description: One of the dragons living in Valka's sanctuary.

name: Valka's Mercy
description: One of the dragons living in Valka's sanctuary.

name: Soaring Sidekick
description: A Timberjack seen in the second film.

name: Bonesnarl
description: A Thunderclaw seen in the second film.

name: Fishmeat
description: A Gronckle linked to Fishlegs in the third film.
